summary.text: Yang Pass Tune is Feng Jiu Ge's self-created immortal killer move. He uses it to teleport, vanishing in golden light that has no offensive power.

claims.text: He tells Fang Yuan’s group he could arrive because the move has not ended yet. An ancient zither tune grows louder and softer, as if the player is moving around them. Fang Yuan remembers this movement method from the five regions chaotic war: Feng Jiu Ge turns into formless sound waves, moves, and turns back into human. The method is extremely unique, so normal methods cannot restrict that movement. In anti-sound desert, sound path dao marks are suppressed and sound path killer moves are greatly weakened. He still uses it to dodge Fang Yuan, to teleport away from Bai Ning Bing’s cold eyes, and to leave again when reverse flow protection seal reflects a portion of his own attack. The others hear the zither and retreat, but they are slower than this move and do not know his exact location.

He jumps as the move activates and goes to the center of the battlefield. It does not fade. Its aura changes abruptly, and a green jade figure like him emerges while green jade song is running. Fang Yuan reads that famous song warrior as a variation of this move, similar to myriad self and strength path giant hand. He uses it again to move far from Fang Yuan, several times, before using another signature killer move.

The movement killer move is superb and can contain song warrior, but each activation lasts a limited amount of time. Once that time is up, the effect vanishes, and he can use it again only after fourteen hours. He does not use it casually in normal battles, because if he cannot end the fight in time he lacks a better movement method to leave. When Fang Yuan uses myriad dragon, the limit is already up, so Feng Jiu Ge defends with drum fist and bell palm instead.

He vanishes on the spot and appears a thousand steps away. The ancient sword dragon Fang Yuan has become cannot tear open space and can only travel rapidly in a straight line. This move has the power of space path and can teleport Feng Jiu Ge to an entirely new location, so even sword escape Immortal Gu cannot match it on that point.
